T01.name_zh: 精密刀刻 / 钢凹版视觉
T01.primary_zh: 以端点收细、宽窄受控的刀刻线为主要造型手段；线段长短、转向与疏密服从局部表面，不把所有区域铺成长排线。
T01.primary_en: Model form with tapered, controlled-width burin strokes; adapt stroke length, curvature and spacing to each local surface instead of covering every region with long parallel bands.
T01.tone_zh: 明暗由线距、刻线粗细、成束方向与留白转换；交叉线仅点到为止，保持轮廓干净。
T01.tone_en: Modulate tone with spacing, line width, directional bands and untouched paper; cross-hatching remains minimal.
T01.edge_zh: 轮廓刀锋般清晰，转折处用刻线终止与疏密变化；避免机械等距网屏。
T01.edge_en: Crisp cutting edges, with line terminations and spacing changes at form boundaries; never a mechanical screen.
T01.avoid_zh: 不要把点阵、模糊毛边或大面积连续黑调子作为主表现。
T01.avoid_en: Do not replace the main technique with dotted fields, fuzzy edges, or seamless black tonal blankets.
T01.application_zh: 分区用线：主体亮面保留原有浅色与开阔纸白，中间调用疏密渐变塑造体积；暗部保留结构间的浅色分隔，不压成连续黑块。原图已有的大面积平滑亮区优先保留平整原色或纸白，不铺连续排线；若原图有晴空，不得用连续水平线填满蓝天，仅在已有云团的体积转折处使用少量短而收细的弧线；已有波纹或纹理保留其透视与尺度变化，不延展成跨物体的整齐网屏。不得凭本段指令添加原图不存在的场景区域；纸感保持细微，不以全图黄褐染色或噪点制造复古感。
T01.application_en: Use region-specific strokes: preserve source light colors and open paper on lit subject planes, grade line spacing through midtones, and keep light separations between shadow structures instead of solid black blocks. Broad smooth bright regions already in the source stay sparsely marked or unmarked, preserving flat original colors or paper white. If clear sky exists in the source, keep it free of continuous horizontal hatching; use sparse short tapered arcs only at existing cloud form transitions. Existing ripples or textures retain perspective and scale changes without becoming a grid across objects. These instructions introduce no new scene regions. Keep paper texture subtle; do not create age by yellow-brown tinting or all-over noise.

T02.primary_zh: 由笔触感明确、轻微不等距的蚀刻线组织形体；转折、材质和受力决定刻线组方向。
T02.primary_en: Dominant slightly irregular etched drawn lines, grouped by contour, material and local tension rather than a rigid grid.
T02.tone_zh: 用交叉排线的层数、角度变化和局部断线建调子；在关键结构保留开放纸白。
T02.tone_en: Build values through intersecting hatch layers, direction changes and broken lines, preserving open unprinted spaces at key forms.
T02.edge_zh: 边缘有手工绘线的活性，不是齐刷刷的刀口和不间断同向条纹。
T02.edge_en: Edges have lively drawn-line character rather than uniform, continuous, machine-parallel strokes.
T02.avoid_zh: 不要以无方向的均匀点刻或平滑暗调代替蚀刻线。
T02.avoid_en: Avoid replacing etched linear construction with uniform dots or smoothly blended dark masses.

T03.primary_zh: 以有压强轻重差异的短中程划痕刻线为主体，线缘带轻微储墨毛刺和绒感。
T03.primary_en: Dominant pressure-variable short-to-medium scratched lines with restrained ink-burr softness along the marks.
T03.tone_zh: 通过断续线簇与柔绒深浅构建体积，最深处仍见局部刻痕方向；高光由未着墨纸面打开。
T03.tone_en: Create form through broken clusters of scratched strokes and soft velvety depth, retaining local mark direction even in shadows; use bare paper for highlights.
T03.edge_zh: 接触边缘略带自然柔化，但主体身份和形体边界必须可靠。
T03.edge_en: Slightly feathered inked edges, but subject silhouette and defining geometry stay accurate.
T03.avoid_zh: 不要工业式等距排线、规则点阵或整图磨砂噪点。
T03.avoid_en: No industrial equally spaced hatching, regular dot screens, or all-over gritty noise.

T04.primary_zh: 以彼此分离的、疏密与大小受控的雕刻墨点作为主体调子；轮廓只允许极少量清晰辅助线。
T04.primary_en: Dominant separated engraved dots of controlled density and size; permit only sparse precise outlines as support.
T04.tone_zh: 明暗主要靠局部点密与点径阶梯塑形，沿形体变化而非随机散点；纸白亮区点量极少。
T04.tone_en: Model values primarily with graded local dot frequency and size that follow form, not random speckle; bright paper zones stay nearly dot-free.
T04.edge_zh: 柔顺的点群过渡配合精准外轮廓，小图识别性不能丢失。
T04.edge_en: Smooth dotted transitions with faithful silhouettes; recognizable at thumbnail scale.
T04.avoid_zh: 禁止连续平行排线、明显交叉排线、连续黑色喷绘渐变作为主要阴影方式。
T04.avoid_en: No continuous parallel hatching, conspicuous cross-hatching, or digital airbrush gradients as the main shading method.

T05.primary_zh: 以极细密摇刀颗粒形成的均匀深墨基调为主体，明亮区域通过刮削与磨光从暗底中显现。
T05.primary_en: Dominant velvet-rich tonal plate texture, as if prepared by mezzotint rocking; reveal lights through selective scraping and burnishing.
T05.tone_zh: 用连续但具有版画颗粒感的黑—灰—纸白明度塑造体积，而不是用长排线覆盖照片。
T05.tone_en: Model values through rich, print-grained continuous dark-to-light tonality rather than long hatch lines over a photograph.
T05.edge_zh: 暗部沉厚、亮部柔顺，焦点的形体轮廓仍清晰；不把整幅暗化。
T05.edge_en: Deep shadows and soft luminous regions with legible focal contours; do not blacken the entire scene.
T05.avoid_zh: 不得把大量交叉排线、点阵筛网或喷枪渐变伪装为美柔汀。
T05.avoid_en: Do not substitute dense cross-hatching, a digital dot screen, or airbrush gradients for mezzotint plate character.
